description:
Create a new permission group for regulatory auditors. 

Log in to the Django admin panel (http://localhost:8000/admin/) with username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'. 

Create a new Group named 'Regulatory Auditors'. 

Assign exactly the following 6 view-only permissions to this group:
1. registry | aircraft | Can view aircraft
2. registry | contact | Can view contact
3. registry | operator | Can view operator
4. registry | person | Can view person
5. gcs_operations | flight operation | Can view flight operation
6. gcs_operations | flight plan | Can view flight plan

Ensure the group has NO 'add', 'change', or 'delete' permissions. Save the group.
